name: 1.23.0-beta.3
notes: Ren'Py games: sound works. Ren'Py's web version could not play music and sounds kept in the game's .rpa archives (where most games keep them); they are now handed to Ren'Py as plain files, without using extra memory.
Enter works in the game's text boxes (for example when a game asks for your name).
A game's cover is now a picture of its main menu, taken by itself the first time you play. Or tap Cover on the game's page to pick any picture from the game, including those inside its archives.

Games can go into a gallery's folders: tap Move on the game's page, drop a game while a gallery or folder is open, or use Add → “Add a Ren'Py game” inside a gallery. If its folder is deleted, the game goes back to the library.
